the international community has already taken steps to address many of the security risks posed by AI and robotics, but more is needed.

how the international legal system is evolving in response to AI and robotics, with a particular focus on the security implications.

the international legal system is not only capable of responding to new technological developments but is also actively doing so.
the global community is not waiting for the development of a comprehensive AI treaty or a new legal framework to govern AI and robotics.
